items.stem: 2n + 6 = 14 A tree had a height of 6 feet when it was planted. The equation above can be used to find how many years n it took the tree to reach a height of 14 feet. Which of the following is the best interpretation of the number 2 in this context?

The monthly sales revenue, in dollars, from each tape dispenser sold
The monthly cost, in dollars, of creating each tape dispenser
The monthly cost, in dollars, of creating x tape dispensers
items.answer_value: The monthly sales revenue, in dollars, from selling x tape dispensers
